source: pump-manual page 68, table 6.6 'Relation between amount of water, pressure and size of the water-jet nozzle (orifice)'. Flow in l/min of pure water through a sapphire/ruby/diamond orifice of the given diameter (in thousandths of an inch) at the given pressure (psi).

pump_limits.JETS 3.8/60-COMPACT with 60K intensifier: 3.8 l/min at 4130 bar (60 000 psi) - never fit an orifice (or combination) that exceeds this, the intensifier over-strokes (>110 cycles/min) and the pump faults

pressure_levels_pump_panel.source: pump-manual page 12 - preset pressure levels selected with buttons 1-9 / 0 on the pump control panel (hydraulic oil pressure -> output water pressure)

levels.function: quick switch between the LO and HI presets

pressure_levels_pump_panel.intensification_ratio: approx. 19.5 : 1 (212 bar oil -> 4130 bar water with the 60K intensifier; the control recalculates HPW from oil pressure with 'Constant mult.' when no HP sensor P4 is fitted)
